result.message:
Please review the proposed scope for the Russian-language website. The English version is not included. The scope is awaiting your approval.

The price is set out in the attached proposal. At this stage, we are asking only for agreement on scope; this request does not ask you to accept the price, authorize work or place an order.

Please confirm whether you agree with the proposed scope, or reply with questions, requested changes or a decision to decline. If someone else needs to approve the scope, please let us know who should review it.
